model_meta.system_name: Robotic Tool Changer with Piston Retardation
model_meta.description: Concept model of a robotic tool changer that couples a master unit to a tool unit using piston-driven rolling members, with failsafe/retarding geometry resisting unintended movement toward unlock.

subsystems.description: First unit, typically connected to a robotic arm; includes the illustrated piston chamber and rolling-member retention structure.

parts.description: Deformable O-ring seated in the master-unit central opening

subsystems.description: Movable fluid-actuated piston with head/contact area, stem, locking surface, and failsafe/retarding surface; stem step interacts with the deformable opening seal.

ports.name: Stem step contact with opening seal

subsystems.description: Plural rolling members held in apertures of the master-unit annular ring and contacted by piston surfaces to couple the units.
Second unit, typically connected to a tool; includes a locking race with a surface engaged by the rolling members.

Abstract external fluid-supply context element used to represent the pressurized-fluid input to the piston in this system model; it is a modeling boundary abstraction, not a patent-specified source component or supply architecture. The patent describes pressurized-fluid actuation and pneumatic movement in one embodiment.
Deformable O-ring seated in the master-unit central opening; stem step engagement slightly deforms it and retards piston travel in the disclosed variant.

ports.name: Deformable seal contact with piston step

item_flows.name: Pressurized actuation fluid
item_flows.notes: Conceptual fluid input at the model boundary for piston actuation. The patent describes a pressurized fluid source and pneumatic movement as one embodiment, but does not specify this modeled external-source subsystem or its supply topology.

item_flows.name: Locking contact force
item_flows.notes: Piston surface urges rolling members against the tool-unit locking-race surface.

item_flows.name: Stem-step to opening-seal contact
item_flows.notes: Mechanical contact between the piston stem step and deformable opening seal; slight seal deformation retards piston movement in the disclosed variant.

steps.description: Pressurized-fluid actuation moves the piston toward the locked position; the external source and interface are represented abstractly, without specifying a fluid route into the chamber.
The piston locking surface engages the rolling members and urges them outward against the tool-unit locking-race surface, coupling the units.

actions.name: Retard unintended piston movement toward unlock

steps.description: If actuating force is interrupted, the piston may move from locked toward a failsafe position while the failsafe surface remains engaged with the rolling members.

As the piston advances toward unlocked, an outwardly projecting retarding surface engages the rolling members and creates an opposing force that must be overcome; disclosed surface geometries include a ridge or, alternatively, a conical surface.
In a disclosed stem-step variant, the stem step engages and slightly deforms the opening O-ring, retarding further piston travel.
